scenario.topic: Decide which museum pass to buy for a visit to Paris

options.name: Paris Museum Pass 2-Day
options.upside: Allows entry to 50 museums with consecutive 2-day use within a 3-day window.
options.concern: Short validity may limit the number of museums visited during a 3-day trip.

options.name: Paris Museum Pass 4-Day
options.upside: Covers 50 museums with 4 consecutive days of access within a 6-day period.
options.concern: Higher cost and longer validity than the trip length might reduce cost efficiency.

options.name: Paris Museum Pass 3-Day
options.upside: Offers 3 consecutive days access to 50 museums within a 5-day window, matching trip length closely.
options.concern: Slightly more expensive than 2-day pass with only one extra day of validity.

options.name: Paris Museum Pass 1-Day
options.upside: Lower price for a single day of access to 50 museums, suitable for focused visits.
options.concern: Limited to one day, restricting the number of museums that can be visited during the trip.
